web.title: Why Half of GenAI Projects Fail: Avoid These 5 Common Mistakes
web.description: More than 50% of GenAI projects are abandoned after proof of concept. Discover five critical failure points and proven strategies to beat the odds with your AI initiatives.
snippets: When organizations chase flashy demos or deploy GenAI everywhere simultaneously, they dilute resources across low-impact initiatives. Without clear prioritization frameworks or success metrics, projects lack measurable business value, making them easy targets when budgets tighten or executives demand proof of ROI.
